title: Made a tool to remove SynthIDs from images
body: As you know, whenever you edit an image via Gemini or OpenAI, they plaster a SynthID to mark it as their own. Further, these SynthIDs can be unqiue, which could be used to track whoever made it. This SynthIDs are imposed on even paid users, and cannot be opted out of this. In response, I created this scrubber. Works on any computer with 8GB of ram. Pretty reliable, automatic, but sucks with text. Have fun. submitted
